## This analysis incorporates all statistical and graphical analyses of the spat transcriptomes generated in the multiple stressor trial run in November 2022. The aim of this study was to determine if multiple stressors in the form of temperature (ocean heatwaves) and harmful algae blooms have a detrimental impact on the survival of GSM spat.

### Loading the data

```{r}
#Set wd
setwd("C:/Users/hannahg/Cawthron/Hannah G PhD Team - Documents/General/R/Julien/Spat_sediment")

#GO contains GO terms for some genes
GO = read.csv('musselblast2go_annot.csv')
ProteinModels_swissprot_diamond=read.csv('ProteinModels_swissprot_diamond.csv')
ProteinModels_diamond=read.csv('ProteinModels_diamond.csv')
go_swiss=read.csv('go_swiss.csv') # GO term annotations with descriptions
annot_master=read.csv('annotation_master.csv') # master annotation with GO terms (term_name) and diamond descriptions (full_name)

#Count data
fcData = read.csv('featurecounts_SMS.csv', check.names = FALSE, header = TRUE)
fcData

# Coldata contains sample information/metadata- must match sample IDs in the count data!!
coldata = read.csv("metadata.csv", header=TRUE)
coldata


####Remove annotations so table shows only gene id and sample counts
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sample_id
#remove sample_id column which is now duplicated
coldata <- coldata[ , !(colnames(coldata) %in% "sample_id")]

#Convert geneids to be rownames
rownames(fcData) <- fcData$Geneid
#remove geneid column which is now duplicated
fcData <- fcData[ , !(colnames(fcData) %in% "Geneid")]
fcData
####Check the samples in the count data table and metadata table match up
all.equal(colnames(fcData),rownames(coldata))
setdiff(colnames(fcData), rownames(coldata))


```


##Normalising count data

```{r Data quality assessment and quality control, include=FALSE}
# NOTE: some data normalisation has already been done on a linux preprosessing system.

####remove genes with low counts i.e. must have >5 reads in at least 4 samples
# keep_genes <- rowSums( fcData > 5 ) >= 4
# counts_filtered <- fcData[keep_genes,]
keep_genes <- rowSums(fcData >= 10) >= 2
counts_filtered2 <- fcData[keep_genes,]

#write.csv(as.data.frame(counts_filtered2),file='featurecounts_filtered2.csv')

####Check we haven't lost any samples in the filtering process
all.equal(colnames(counts_filtered2),rownames(coldata)) #TRUE means we still have the same number of samples

```

##Create dds objects so we can run multiple pairwise comparisons based
on different variables

```{r}
# Generate different dds designs based on the comparisons you want to run i.e. treatment and time
# Think about the comparisons you are interested in doing later and write the design accordingly. 
# this part of the code generates the model. You can add interaction effects by adding a semicolon i.e. design=~treatment + time:treatment:time
# Ensure factors
coldata$treatment   <- factor(coldata$treatment, levels = c("control", "sediment"))
coldata$temperature <- factor(coldata$temperature, levels = c("17", "21"))
coldata$temp.treatment.conc <- factor(coldata$temp.treatment.conc)
coldata$sediment_conc <- factor(coldata$sediment_conc, levels = c("0", "25", "50"))
coldata$sediment_location=as.factor(coldata$sediment_location)
coldata$replicate=as.factor(coldata$replicate)

# Build DESeq2 object comparing the two most important factors - temp and sediment conc
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts_filtered2,
    colData   = coldata,
    design    = ~ temperature * sediment_conc
)

dds <- DESeq(dds)

resultsNames(dds)


## temp.treatment.conc 
dds_TTC <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts_filtered2,
    colData   = coldata,
    design    = ~ temp.treatment.conc
)

dds_TTC <- DESeq(dds_TTC)
head(rownames(dds_TTC))

resultsNames(dds_TTC)

# Note: In order to benefit from the default settings of the package, you should put the variable of interest at the end of the formula and make sure the control level is the first level.

# # By default, R will choose a reference level for factors based on alphabetical order. Then, if you never tell the DESeq2 functions which level you want to compare against (e.g. which level represents the control group), the comparisons will be based on the alphabetical order of the levels. There are two solutions: you can either explicitly tell results which comparison to make using the contrast argument (this will be shown later), or you can explicitly set the factors levels. In order to see the change of reference levels reflected in the results names, you need to either run DESeq or nbinomWaldTest/nbinomLRT after the re-leveling operation

## This will print the names of the comparisons you can do later.
resultsNames(dds)


# main effect of treatment
res_treatment <- results(dds, contrast = c("treatment", "sediment", "control"))
#main effect of temperature
res_temperature <- results(dds, contrast = c("temperature", "21", "17"))
# Interaction term, sediment effect differs by temp
res_interaction <- results(dds, name = "treatmentsediment.temperature21")
summary(res_interaction)

# Sediment vs control at 21
res_sediment_21 <- results(dds,
    list(
        c("treatment_sediment_vs_control", "treatmentsediment.temperature21")
    )
)
# Sediment cs control at 17 deg
res_sediment_17 <- results(dds,
    list(
        c("treatment_sediment_vs_control")
    )
)
```

##VSD matrices
```{r}
## Data tranformation for QC
# vsd is a much faster transformation step than rlog 
# Do this to do some PCA and plot visualisations of normalised data before you move to differential gene expression testing
# Want blind=true for the vst function doesn't take the sample groups into account i.e. does transformation in unbiased manner
# Blind= true is important for doing QC steps. However, it is not appropriate when you expect that majority of genes will have large diffs in counts due to experimental design
# Use blind=false for downstream analysis
# vsd_temp <- DESeq2:::vst(dds_temp, blind=TRUE)
# vsd_mat_temp <- assay(vsd_temp)


vsd     <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
vsd_mat <- assay(vsd)


vsd_TTC     <- vst(dds_TTC, blind = TRUE)
vsd_mat_TTC <- assay(vsd_TTC)



# vsd_TT <- DESeq2:::vst(dds_TT, blind=TRUE)
# vsd_mat_TT <- assay(vsd_TT)
# 
# # r log transform- takes longer if you have a large data set
# rld_TT <- rlog(dds_TT, blind = FALSE)
# rld_mat_<- assay(rld_TT)

# plots the standard deviation of the transformed data, across samples, against the mean, using the shifted logarithm transformation, and the variance stabilizing transformation. The shifted logarithm has elevated standard deviation in the higher count range, while for the variance stabilized data the standard deviation is roughly constant along the whole dynamic range.


# head(assay(rld_TT), 3)
# meanSdPlot(assay(rld_TT), ranks=FALSE)

# meanSdPlot(assay(vsd_genes))


```

#### Treatment * Temperature

```{r PCA temp, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# PCA
#matrix for plots
 p_temp <- pca(vsd_mat_temp, metadata = coldata, removeVar = 0.1)
p_temp  
# screeplot
screeplot(p_temp, axisLabSize = 18, titleLabSize = 22)

#biplot
 biplot(p_temp)
 biplot(p_temp, showLoadings = TRUE,
    labSize = 5, pointSize = 5, sizeLoadingsNames = 5)
 
#pairsplot 
pairsplot(p_temp)

   
horn <- parallelPCA(vsd_mat_temp)
  horn$n
  which(cumsum(p$variance) > 80)[1]
  
# annotated PCA plot
 tiff("PCA_temp.tiff", units="cm", width=30, height=20, res=300) 
  biplot(p_temp,
         x= "PC1", y="PC2",
         labSize= 4,
         pointSize = 4,
    lab = paste0(p_temp$metadata$temperature),
    colby = 'temperature',
     shapeby= 'treatment',
    colkey = c("17"="#41B3A3",'21'= "#E27D60" ),
    hline = 0, vline = 0,
    # colLegendTitle = substitute(paste(italic('A. pacificum '), "concentration")),
    legendPosition = 'none',
     axisLabSize = 12)
   dev.off()
   
   
# PCA via prcomp
pca_obj <- prcomp(t(vsd_mat), scale. = TRUE)

pca_df <- data.frame(
    sample      = colnames(vsd_mat),
    PC1         = pca_obj$x[,1],
    PC2         = pca_obj$x[,2],
    temperature = coldata$temperature,
    treatment   = coldata$treatment
)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                   color = temperature,
                   shape = treatment)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("17"="#41B3A3", "21"="#E27D60")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("control" = 16, "sediment" = 17)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())   
   

#PCA for temp and sediment location
pca_obj <- prcomp(t(vsd_mat), scale. = TRUE)

pca_df <- data.frame(
    sample      = rownames(coldata),
    PC1         = pca_obj$x[,1],
    PC2         = pca_obj$x[,2],
    temperature = coldata$temperature,
    treatment   = coldata$treatment,
    sediment_location = coldata$sediment_location,
    sediment_conc = coldata$sediment_conc
)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                   color = temperature,
                   shape = sediment_location)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("17"="#41B3A3", "21"="#E27D60")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("FSW" = 16, "SK_A" = 17, "SK_B" = 15)) +
    labs(
        x = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_obj)$importance[2,1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
        y = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_obj)$importance[2,2] * 100, 1), "%)")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )

#Left panel: control samples (FSW only)
#Right panel: sediment samples (SK_A and SK_B)
ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2,
                   color = temperature,
                   shape = sediment_location)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("17"="#41B3A3", "21"="#E27D60")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("FSW" = 16, "SK_A" = 17, "SK_B" = 15)) +
    facet_wrap(~ treatment) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)

#faceted by temp
ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2,
                   color = sediment_location,
                   shape = treatment)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FSW"="#999999", "SK_A"="#E27D60", "SK_B"="#41B3A3")) +
    facet_wrap(~ temperature) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)

#with elipses to show clusters
ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2,

# with elipses

## RDA model
library(vegan)

# transpose because RDA expects samples as rows
rda_obj <- rda(t(vsd_mat) ~ temperature * sediment_conc, data = coldata)

anova(rda_obj, by = "terms")
anova(rda_obj)


library(ggplot2)
pca_df$sediment_conc <- as.numeric(as.character(pca_df$sediment_conc))
unique(pca_df$sediment_conc)




rda_scores <- scores(rda_obj, display = "sites")
rda_vars   <- scores(rda_obj, display = "bp")

rda_df <- data.frame(
  RDA1 = rda_scores[,1],
  RDA2 = rda_scores[,2],
  temperature = coldata$temperature,
  sediment_conc = coldata$sediment_conc,
  treatment = coldata$treatment
)

var_df <- data.frame(
  RDA1 = rda_vars[,1],
  RDA2 = rda_vars[,2],
  variable = rownames(rda_vars)
)

ggplot(rda_df, aes(RDA1, RDA2,
                   color = sediment_conc,
                   shape = temperature)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#999999", high = "#41B3A3") +

  # Make arrows longer and thicker
  geom_segment(data = var_df,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0,
                   xend = RDA1 * 2,  # multiply by 2–3 to lengthen
                   yend = RDA2 * 2),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.35, "cm")),
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 1.2) +

  geom_text(data = var_df,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 2.2, y = RDA2 * 2.2, label = variable),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 5, fontface = "bold") +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "RDA1", y = "RDA2")

# faceted by temp
ggplot(rda_df, aes(RDA1, RDA2,
                   color = sediment_conc)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = treatment), size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#999999", high = "#41B3A3") +

  # Arrows scaled up for visibility
  geom_segment(data = var_df,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0,
                   xend = RDA1 * 2,
                   yend = RDA2 * 2),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.35, "cm")),
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 1.2) +

  geom_text(data = var_df,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 2.2, y = RDA2 * 2.2, label = variable),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 5, fontface = "bold") +

  facet_wrap(~ temperature) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "RDA1", y = "RDA2",
       color = "Sediment conc",
       shape = "Treatment")
```

### Temp vs sediment_conc- main interaction effect
```{r temp vs sediment_conc}
#Extract PCA
pca <- prcomp(t(assay(vsd)))

# Check variance explained by other PCAs
round(var_explained[1:10] * 100, 1)

#compute variance
var_explained <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
pc1_lab <- paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1] * 100, 1), "%)")
pc2_lab <- paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2] * 100, 1), "%)")
pc3_lab <- paste0("PC3 (", round(var_explained[3] * 100, 1), "%)")
pc4_lab <- paste0("PC4 (", round(var_explained[4] * 100, 1), "%)")
pc5_lab <- paste0("PC5 (", round(var_explained[5] * 100, 1), "%)")
pc6_lab <- paste0("PC6 (", round(var_explained[6] * 100, 1), "%)")

#Build df with metadata
pca_df <- data.frame(
  pca$x[,1:10],   # gives PC1–PC10
  temperature = colData(dds)$temperature,
  sediment_conc = colData(dds)$sediment_conc
)

# PCA plot by temp
ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = temperature)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal()+
  xlab(pc1_lab) +
  ylab(pc2_lab)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC3, PC4, color = temperature)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal()+
  xlab(pc3_lab) +
  ylab(pc4_lab)

# PCA plot by sediment_conc
```

```{r}   
library(PCAtools)

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
vsd_mat <- assay(vsd)
pca <- pca(vsd_mat, metadata = colData(dds))



# All data
png("eigencorplot.png", width = 2500, height = 1600, res = 300) 
eigencorplot(pca,
               corMultipleTestCorrection = 'BH',
    metavars = c('temperature','sediment_conc', "replicate"), col = colorRampPalette(c("#41B3A3","white", "#E27D60" ))(100),
#Axis labels
  cexLabX = 1.1,
  cexLabY = 1.1,
  fontLabX = 1,
  fontLabY = 1,
  rotLabX = 45,

  # Axis titles

  cexTitleY = 1.6,
  fontTitleX = 2,
  fontTitleY = 2,

  # Correlation values
  cexCorval = 0.9,
  fontCorval = 1,

  # Main title
  main = "PC1-10 correlations with experimental variables",
  cexMain = 1,
  fontMain = 2,

  # Color key
  cexLabColKey = 0.8
)
  dev.off()
```

### Calculate group centroids and significance of PCA plot interactions
```{r stats on PCAs}

# Compute group centroids for PC1–PC2
centroids <- pca_df %>%
  group_by(temperature, sediment_conc) %>%
  summarise(across(c(PC1, PC2), mean))

# Calculate Euclidean distance between centroids
dist_matrix <- dist(centroids[, c("PC1", "PC2")])
dist_matrix

# Express as % shift relative to total PCA range
range_PC1 <- diff(range(pca_df$PC1))
range_PC2 <- diff(range(pca_df$PC2))
total_range <- sqrt(range_PC1^2 + range_PC2^2)

# Gives table of % shifts between group centroids
percent_shift <- as.matrix(dist_matrix) / total_range * 100
percent_shift

# PERMANOVA on PCA scores
## Interaction
adonis2(
  pca_df[, 1:6] ~ temperature * sediment_conc,
  data = pca_df,
  method = "euclidean"
)


## Each term individually
adonis2(
  pca_df[, 1:6] ~ temperature + sediment_conc + temperature:sediment_conc,
  data = pca_df,
  method = "euclidean",
  by = "terms"
)

# Temp explains 14% of variation
# Sediment conc explains 19% of varitation
# Interaction between the two explains 4.6% of variation
# Warming amplifies or modifies the transcriptomic response to sediment exposure.
```

``` {r fgsea pipeline for investigating interaction}
# Based on dds- for res 50
levels(colData(dds)$temperature)
levels(colData(dds)$sediment_conc)
resultsNames(dds)
design(dds)

res50 <- results(dds, name = "temperature21.sediment_conc50") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("geneid")

gene_list_50 <- res50$stat
names(gene_list_50) <- res50$geneid
gene_list_50 <- sort(gene_list_50, decreasing = TRUE)

# fgsea50 <- fgsea(pathways, gene_list_50)
fgsea50 <- fgsea(
pathways = pathways,
stats = gene_list_50,
minSize = 10,
maxSize = 500
)
fgsea50 <- as.data.frame(fgsea50)

#annotate GO terms
fgsea50_annot <- fgsea50 %>%
  left_join(TERM2NAME, by = c("pathway" = "id"))


# extract top pathways 
top50 <- fgsea50_annot %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice_head(n = 20)

# join fgsea NES back to DESeq2 for ridgeplots
res50_join <- res50 %>%
  left_join(TERM2GENE, by = "geneid") %>%              # adds GO ID
  left_join(TERM2NAME, by = c("id" = "id")) %>%        # adds term_name + ontology
  left_join(fgsea50_annot %>% 
              select(pathway, NES, padj), 
            by = c("id" = "pathway"))                  # adds NES + fgsea padj

# filter for enriched GO terms only
res50_sig <- res50_join %>% filter(!is.na(NES))

# Split by ontology
res50_BP <- res50_sig %>% filter(ontology == "BP")
res50_MF <- res50_sig %>% filter(ontology == "MF")
res50_CC <- res50_sig %>% filter(ontology == "CC")


# generate ridge plot for all ontologies
# Reduce number of enriched pathways shwn on plot
df_top <- res50_sig %>% arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>% slice_head(n = 1000)

# Top 15 for plotting
top_terms_res50 <- res50_sig %>%
  distinct(term_name, NES, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(term_name)

df_top <- res50_sig %>%
  filter(term_name %in% top_terms_res50)

fgsea_all= ggplot(df_top, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = term_name, fill = NES)) +
  geom_density_ridges_gradient(scale = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Interaction: 21°C × 50 % sediment",
       x = "log2FC", y = "GO term")+
theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12))

fgsea50_annot_broaden <- fgsea50_annot %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(

      grepl(
        "ribosom|translation|rRNA|processome",
        term_name,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Protein synthesis",

      grepl(
        "axoneme|flagell|cili|radial spoke",
        term_name,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Ciliary/flagellar function",

      grepl(
        "immune|viral|host",
        term_name,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Immune response",

      grepl(
        "methyl",
        term_name,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Epigenetic regulation",

      grepl(
        "amine|metabolic",
       term_name,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Metabolism",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Join this back to plotting df
res50_join <- res50_join %>%
  left_join(
    fgsea50_annot_broaden %>%
      select(pathway, category),
    by = c("id" = "pathway")
  )


cat_summary <- fgsea50_annot_broaden %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_terms = n(),
    mean_NES = mean(NES)
  )

# Plot
ggplot(cat_summary,
       aes(x = reorder(category, mean_NES),
           y = mean_NES,
           fill = mean_NES)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean NES"
  )
```

```{r 4-panel ridgeplots}
# Add contrast labels
temp_df <- fgsea_temp0_annot %>%
  mutate(Contrast = "Temperature")

sed_df <- fgsea_sed17_annot %>%
  mutate(Contrast = "Sediment")

comb_df <- fgsea_21_50_annot %>%
  mutate(Contrast = "Combined")

inter_df <- fgsea50_annot %>%
  mutate(Contrast = "Interaction")

# Combine
all_fgsea <- bind_rows(
  temp_df,
  sed_df,
  comb_df,
  inter_df
)

# Select top pathways per contrast
plot_df <- all_fgsea %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(padj),
    padj < 0.05
  ) %>%

  group_by(Contrast) %>%

  arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>%

  distinct(term_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%

  slice_head(n = 10) %>%

  ungroup()

# Order plot
plot_df$Contrast <- factor(
plot_df$Contrast,
levels = c(
"Temperature",
"Sediment",
"Combined",
"Interaction"
),
labels = c(
"A. Temperature",
"B. Sediment",
"C. Combined",
"D. Interaction"
)
)

plot_df$term_name <- str_wrap(
  plot_df$term_name,
  width = 30
)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    term_name = reorder_within(
      term_name,
      NES,
      Contrast
    )
  )

# Plot
fgsea_dotplot <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = NES,
    y = term_name,
    colour = NES,
    size = -log10(padj)
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Contrast,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_colour_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
    y = NULL,
    colour = "NES",
    size = "-log10(FDR)"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

### DE gene expression in the 21deg x 50% sediment comparison
```{r DE gene expression}
# Pull out headline genes
DE_interaction <- res50 %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05)

# select for up and down reg
up_genes <- DE_interaction %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0)
down_genes <- DE_interaction %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0)

# Add annotations
DE_annot <- DE_interaction %>%
  left_join(annot_master, by = "geneid")

write.csv(as.data.frame(DE_annot),file='Annotated DE genes.csv')

# Heatmap of DE genes
vsd <- vst(dds)

mat <- assay(vsd)[DE_interaction$geneid, ]
mat <- mat - rowMeans(mat)

#Build annotation df
sample_info <- colData(dds) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(temperature, sediment_conc)


pheatmap(mat,
         annotation_col = sample_info,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         fontsize = 12,
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean")

# Select for fewer genes
top_var <- head(order(rowVars(mat), decreasing = TRUE), 50)
pheatmap(mat[top_var, ],
         annotation_col = sample_info,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         scale = "row",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50))


## Use swissprot annotations on HM
annot_unique <- annot_master %>%
  filter(!is.na(swissprot)) %>%     # keep only annotated rows
  group_by(geneid) %>%
  slice(1) %>%                      # pick first annotated row
  ungroup()


# fallback to diamond if swissprot NA


genes_use <- intersect(DE_interaction$geneid, rownames(vsd))
mat <- assay(vsd)[genes_use, ]

## Use swissprot annotations on HM
annot_unique <- annot_master %>%
  group_by(geneid) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
# fallback to diamond if swissprot NA
labels <- ifelse(
  is.na(annot_unique$swissprot),
  annot_unique$diamond,
  annot_unique$swissprot
)

#Replace rownames
rownames(mat) <- labels[match(genes_use, annot_unique$geneid)]
#remove rownames with NAs
mat <- mat[!is.na(rownames(mat)), ]
top_var <- head(order(rowVars(mat), decreasing = TRUE), 50)

pheatmap(
  mat[top_var, ],
  annotation_col = sample_info,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "row",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50)
)

#identify top20 up regd genes
top_up <- DE_interaction %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

# and down
top_down <- DE_interaction %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

#query annotation table
annot_top_up <- annot_master %>%
  filter(geneid %in% top_up$geneid)

annot_top_down <- annot_master %>%
  filter(geneid %in% top_down$geneid)
```

## Work flow to extract DEGs and analyse with GSEA 
### 21deg 50% sediment conc compared to 21 deg control
```{r DEG extraction from tables, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
## First, want to create a gene_list of all DESeq results from the dds_TTC data
#Contrasts using temp.treatment.time- base it on the full unfiltred gene list
res_21_50_vs_21_0 <- results(dds_TTC, contrast = c("temp.treatment.conc", "21.sediment.50", "21.control.0"))

res_full <- res_21_50_vs_21_0 %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("geneid")



# Create gene list
gene_list <- res_full$log2FoldChange
names(gene_list) <- res_full$geneid
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)

#Add the swissprot IDs table
annotated_full <- res_full %>%
  left_join(full_annot2, by = "geneid")

## Helper function for getting GO terms from uniprot
fetch_uniprot_go <- function(uniprot_id) {
  url <- paste0("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/", uniprot_id, ".json")
  res <- try(GET(url), silent = TRUE)
  
  # If request fails, return empty tibble
  if(inherits(res, "try-error") || status_code(res) != 200) {
    return(tibble(uniprot = uniprot_id, id = NA, description = NA))
  }
  
  data <- fromJSON(content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  
  # If GO terms are missing entirely
  if(is.null(data$uniProtKBCrossReferences)) {
    return(tibble(uniprot = uniprot_id, id = NA, description = NA))
  }
  
  # Extract only GO entries
  go_entries <- data$uniProtKBCrossReferences %>%
    filter(database == "GO")
  
  if(nrow(go_entries) == 0) {
    return(tibble(uniprot = uniprot_id, id = NA, description = NA))
  }
  
  # Safely extract GO term + description
  out <- tibble(
    uniprot = uniprot_id,
    id = go_entries$id,
    description = map_chr(go_entries$properties, ~ .x$term %||% NA)
  )
  
  return(out)
}

# extract GO IDs from swissprot data
swiss_ids   <- unique(annotated_full$swissprot)
swiss_ids   <- swiss_ids[!is.na(swiss_ids)]


#Fetch Go terms
go_swiss <- map_df(swiss_ids, fetch_uniprot_go)
write.csv(as.data.frame(go_swiss),file='go_swiss.csv')


# Merge GO terms back to the full DEseq2 table
annotated_go <- annotated_full %>%
  left_join(go_swiss, by = c("swissprot" = "uniprot"))

# remove duplicate genes
annotated_go_clean <- annotated_go %>%
  filter(!is.na(id)) %>%                         # remove NA GO IDs
  distinct(id, geneid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%     # remove duplicated GO–gene pairs
  mutate(description = Term(id)) %>%             # fetch GO term names
  mutate(description = ifelse(is.na(description), id, description))

# Exract ontolog
```

### John P Fgsea method
```{r John P fgsea protocol}


res_21_50_vs_21_0 <- results(dds_TTC, contrast = c("temp.treatment.conc", "21.sediment.50", "21.control.0"))

res_full <- res_21_50_vs_21_0 %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("transcript_id")

pathways <- split(TERM2GENE$geneid, TERM2GENE$id)

# Create gene list
gene_list <- res_full$log2FoldChange
names(gene_list) <- res_full$transcript_id
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)

library(fgsea)

fgsea_res <- fgsea(
  pathways = pathways,
  stats = gene_list,
  minSize = 10,
  maxSize = 500
)

fgsea_df <- as.data.frame(fgsea_res)

fgsea_df <- fgsea_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(leading_edge_genes = leadingEdge)


df_joined <- left_join(
  res_full,
  TERM2GENE,
  by = c("transcript_id" = "geneid")
)

df_joined <- left_join(
  df_joined,
  TERM2NAME,
  by = c("id" = "id")
)

df_joined <- left_join(
  df_joined,
  fgsea_df %>% select(pathway, NES),
  by = c("id" = "pathway")
)


df_enriched <- df_joined %>% 
  filter(!is.na(NES), padj <= 0.05)


library(ggridges)

ggplot(df_enriched, aes(x = NES, y = reorder(description, NES), fill = NES)) +
  geom_density_ridges_gradient(scale = 2, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C") +
  theme_ridges() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  xlab("Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)")

# Reduce number of enriched pathways shwn on plot
df_top <- df_enriched %>% arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>% slice_head(n = 300)

ggplot(df_top, aes(
    x = log2FoldChange,
    y = description,
    fill = NES
)) +
  geom_density_ridges_gradient(scale = 3, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_clean()

# To separate ontologies
TERM2GENE <- annotated_go_clean %>% select(id, geneid)
TERM2NAME <- annotated_go_clean %>% select(id, description) %>% distinct()

# Biological process
```

## Barplot to look at up and down reg DEGs and compare to survival

```{r Barplot DEGs}

res_temp <- results(dds, name = "temperature_21_vs_17")

res_25_17 <- results(dds, name = "sediment_conc_25_vs_0")

res_50_17 <- results(dds, name = "sediment_conc_50_vs_0")


res_25_21 <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(
    c("sediment_conc_25_vs_0",
      "temperature21.sediment_conc25")
  )
)

res_50_21 <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(
    c("sediment_conc_50_vs_0",
      "temperature21.sediment_conc50")
  )
)


## Function to count DEGs
count_DEGs <- function(res,
                       padj_cutoff = 0.05,
                       lfc_cutoff = 1) {

  sig <- res[
    !is.na(res$padj) &
    res$padj < padj_cutoff &
    abs(res$log2FoldChange) > lfc_cutoff,
  ]

  data.frame(
    Up = sum(sig$log2FoldChange > 0),
    Down = sum(sig$log2FoldChange < 0)
  )
}


# Count genes for each comparison
counts <- rbind(
  cbind(Comparison = "21 °C vs 17 °C (0%)",
        Direction = c("Up","Down"),
        Count = unlist(count_DEGs(res_temp))),

  cbind(Comparison = "25 % vs 0 % sediment (17°C)",
        Direction = c("Up","Down"),
        Count = unlist(count_DEGs(res_25_17))),

  cbind(Comparison = "50 % vs 0 % sediment (17°C)",
        Direction = c("Up","Down"),
        Count = unlist(count_DEGs(res_50_17))),

  cbind(Comparison = "25 % vs 0 % sediment (21°C)",
        Direction = c("Up","Down"),
        Count = unlist(count_DEGs(res_25_21))),

  cbind(Comparison = "50 % vs 0 % sediment (21°C)",
        Direction = c("Up","Down"),
        Count = unlist(count_DEGs(res_50_21)))
)

counts <- as.data.frame(counts)
counts$Count <- as.numeric(counts$Count)


# Diverging barplot

counts$Count_plot <- ifelse(
  counts$Direction == "Down",
  -counts$Count,
  counts$Count
)


ggplot(counts,
       aes(x = Comparison,
           y = Count_plot,
           fill = Direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Up" = "firebrick",
    "Down" = "steelblue"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of DEGs"
  ) +
  coord_flip()

#DEG counts for each treatment combination relative to the reference condition (17°C, 0%):
# 21°C, 0% vs 17°C, 0%
res_21_0 <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = c("temperature", "21", "17")

#17°C, 25% vs 17°C, 0%

res_17_50 <- results(

#21°C, 25% vs 17°C, 0%

# Build plotting df

  data.frame(

  ),

  ),

  data.frame(
    Treatment = "17 °C, 50 %",
    Direction = c("Up","Down"),
    Count = unlist(count_DEGs(res_17_50))
  ),

  data.frame(
    Treatment = "21 °C, 25 %",

    Count = unlist(count_DEGs(res_21_25))
  ),

  data.frame(
    Treatment = "21 °C, 50 %",

)

plot_df$Count <- as.numeric(plot_df$Count)

# Create barplot

  plot_df$Direction == "Down",
  -plot_df$Count,
  plot_df$Count
)

DEGS_vs_ref= ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = Treatment,
           y = Count_plot,
           fill = Direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = abs(Count)),
          hjust = ifelse(plot_df$Count_plot > 0, -0.2, 1.2),

library(dplyr)

# Add reference, assume it's 0 (as it's compared to itself)
DEG_summary <- rbind(
  data.frame(

# Linear model

)


library(ggplot2)

Corr= ggplot(DEG_summary,

 theme(
```

### Investigate GO enrichment from interaction plots
```{r GO}

head(annot_master[, c("geneid","id")])


library(dplyr)

geneID2GO <- annot_master %>%
  filter(!is.na(id)) %>%
  group_by(geneid) %>%
  summarise(GO = list(unique(id))) %>%
  tibble::deframe()

geneID2GO[[1]]

# Define genes of interest i.e. those in the 50% sediment * 21deg comparison
sig_int50 <- subset(
  as.data.frame(res_int50),
  padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1
)

genes_interest <- rownames(
  subset(
    as.data.frame(res_int50),
    padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1
  )
)


# Define background genes i.e. all genes tested in dds
all_genes <- rownames(dds)

# Create factor indicating DEGs
geneList <- factor(
  as.integer(all_genes %in% genes_interest)
)

names(geneList) <- all_genes


# Run topGO
GOdata <- new(
  "topGOdata",
  ontology = "BP",
  allGenes = geneList,
  annot = annFUN.gene2GO,
  gene2GO = geneID2GO
)

# Run Fishers exact test
resultFis <- runTest(
  GOdata,
  algorithm = "weight01",
  statistic = "fisher"
)

# Extract enriched terms
go_results <- GenTable(
  GOdata,
  Fisher = resultFis,
  topNodes = 30
)

head(go_results)


# Plot top GO terms
go_results$Fisher <- as.numeric(go_results$Fisher)

go_results <- go_results[
  order(go_results$Fisher),
]

# Plot

ggplot(
  head(go_results, 15),
  aes(
    x = reorder(Term, -log10(Fisher)),
    y = -log10(Fisher)
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "-log10(p-value)"
  )
```

```{r candidates}
  "RAD51",
  "RAD54",
  "MRE11",
  "ATRIP",
  "CHK1",
  "CHK2",
  "ATM",
  "apurinic",

  # Epigenetic regulation

  "histone",
  "HDAC",
  "PRMT",
  "RBBP",
  "deacetylase",

  # Translation / ribosome
  "ribosomal protein",
  "RPL",
  "RPS",
  "MRPL",
  "MRPS",
  "eIF",
  "elongation factor",
  "translation initiation",
  "translation elongation",
  "rRNA processing",

  # Cilia / flagella
  "dynein",
  "dynein assembly factor",
  "kinesin",
  "tektin",
  "CFAP",
  "flagellar",
  "axonemal",
  "radial spoke",
  "radial spoke head",
  "intraflagellar transport",
  "IFT",

  # Cytoskeleton
  "Actin beta",
  "Actin gamma",
  "Actin-binding",
  "Dynactin",

  # Energy metabolism
  "ATP synthase",
  "NADH dehydrogenase",
  "succinate dehydrogenase",
  "citrate synthase",
  "cytochrome c oxidase",
  "electron transport",
  "oxidative phosphorylation",

)


# Looking at 21 deg, 50% sediment vs 17 deg, 0% sediment
res_21_50 <- results(
dds,
contrast = list(
c(
"temperature_21_vs_17",
"sediment_conc_50_vs_0",
"temperature21.sediment_conc50"
)))

res21_50_annot <- as.data.frame(res_21_50) %>%
  rownames_to_column("geneid") %>%
  left_join(
    annot_master %>%
      select(geneid, diamond, full_name),
    by = "geneid"
  )

# Search res_21_50 for candidate genes
candidate_hits <- res21_50_annot %>%
  mutate(
    matched_term = sapply(
      full_name,
      function(x) {

        hits <- candidate_genes[
sapply(
candidate_genes,
function(g)
grepl(
paste0("\\b", g, "\\b"),
x,
ignore.case = TRUE
)
)
        ]

        if(length(hits) == 0) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          paste(hits, collapse = "; ")
        }
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(matched_term)) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(

      grepl(
        "MyD88|Toll|TLR|TNF|TRAF|lectin|lysozyme|complement|IRAK|NFAT|RelA|RelB|Fibrinogen-related protein|FREP|C1q",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Immune signalling",

      grepl(
        "Glutathione|GST|GPx|Peroxidase|peroxiredoxin|thioredoxin|superoxide dismutase|glutaredoxin|superoxide dismutase|heme oxygenase|glutathione peroxidase|glutamate cysteine ligase|heme oxygenase|SOD1|SOD2",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Oxidative stress / Detoxification",

      grepl(
        "DNA repair|DNA mismatch repair protein|BRCA|MSH|PARP|XRCC|PMS2|RAD50|RAD51|RAD54|MRE11|ATRIP|CHK1|RAD23|CHK2|MSH2|MSH3|MSH5|MSH6",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "DNA repair",

      grepl(
        "dynein|tubulin|CFAP|flagellar|intraflagellar transport|kinesin|axonemal|radial spoke|IFT|dynein assembly factor|tektin|Dynactin|radial spoke head",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Ciliary function",

      grepl(
        "eIF|elongation factor|translation initiation|ribosomal protein|RPL|RPS|Translation elongation factor|rRNA processing|MRPS|MRPL",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Translation / Ribosome",

      grepl(
        "methyltransferase|histone|deacetylase|HDAC|PRMT|RBBP",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Epigenetic regulation",

      grepl(
        "HSP|heat shock|DNAJ|HIF|AMPK|FoxO|MAPK|JNK|p38|ERK|heat shock factor|HSP27",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Stress response",

      grepl(
        "caspase|apoptosis|p53|BAX|BCL|p53|death receptor|BAX|BCL",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Cell death / Apoptosis",
      
      grepl(
        "metallothionein|ABC transporter|cytochrome P450|CYP",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Metal / Contaminant response",
      
      grepl(
        "NADH dehydrogenase|cytochrome c oxidase|ATPase|electron transport|mitochondrial",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Energy metabolism",
      
      grepl(
        "Actin beta|Actin gamma|Actin binding proteins",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Cytoskeleton",


      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

write.csv(candidate_hits, "Candidate_hits_combined_trt.csv")




# Create a summary table
candidate_summary <- candidate_hits %>%
  select(
    geneid,
    Category,
    full_name,
    matched_term,
    log2FoldChange,
    stat,
    pvalue,
    padj
  ) %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Reduce table to unique genes
candidate_unique <- candidate_summary %>%
  distinct(geneid, .keep_all = TRUE)

write.csv(candidate_unique, "Candidate_hits_combined_trt.csv")

# Significant candiate hits
candidate_hits_sig <- candidate_unique %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05)

# Sort by padj
candidate_hits_sig %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  select(
    full_name,
    log2FoldChange,
    padj
  )

write.csv(candidate_hits_sig, "Candidate_genes_res2150vres170.csv")

candidate_hits_sig %>%
  count(matched_term)

candidate_hits_grouped=candidate_hits_sig %>%
  group_by(matched_term) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log2FC = mean(log2FoldChange),
    n = n()
  )


#### Make a heatmap
## Create candidate gene list of most significant genes
candidate_genes <- candidate_hits_sig %>%
  filter(padj < 0.01) %>%
  pull(geneid)

# Extract vsd expression values

vsd <- vst(dds)

mat <- assay(vsd)[candidate_genes, ]

# Creat sample annotations
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Temperature = colData(dds)$temperature,
  Sediment = colData(dds)$sediment_conc
)

rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(mat)

# Add gene categories
gene_categories <- candidate_unique %>%
  select(geneid, matched_term) %>%
  distinct()

rownames(gene_categories) <- gene_categories$geneid

annotation_row <- data.frame(
  Category = gene_categories[
    rownames(mat),
    "matched_term"
  ]
)

rownames(annotation_row) <- rownames(mat)

# Plot heatmap

pheatmap(
  mat,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_row = annotation_row,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  fontsize = 10
)

# Top genes from each category

heatmap_genes <- candidate_unique %>%
  distinct(geneid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%    # remove duplicates
  group_by(Category) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Category, padj)

gene_ids <- heatmap_genes$geneid

mat <- assay(vsd)[gene_ids, ]

# Use genenames instead of scaffold IDs
rownames(mat) <- paste(
  heatmap_genes$matched_term,
  seq_len(nrow(heatmap_genes)),
  sep = "_"
)

# Create row annotations
annotation_row <- data.frame(
  Category = heatmap_genes$Category
)

rownames(annotation_row) <- rownames(mat)

# Create column annotations
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Temperature = colData(dds)$temperature,
  Sediment = colData(dds)$sediment_conc
)

rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(mat)

# Order samples
sample_order <- with(
  as.data.frame(colData(dds)),
  order(temperature, sediment_conc)
)

mat <- mat[, sample_order]

annotation_col <- annotation_col[sample_order, ]

# Plot heatmap
library(pheatmap)

pheatmap(
  mat,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_row = annotation_row,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 7,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  gaps_row = cumsum(table(heatmap_genes$Category))
)


table(candidate_hits$Category)

candidate_hits %>%
  filter(Category == "Other") %>%
  count(matched_term, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r Temp effect at 50% sediment}
        "dynein|tubulin|CFAP|flagellar|intraflagellar transport|kinesin|axonemal|radial spoke|IFT|dynein assembly factor|tektin|Dynactin|radial spoke head",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Ciliary function",
      
      grepl(
        "eIF|elongation factor|translation initiation|ribosomal protein|RPL|RPS|Translation elongation factor|rRNA processing|MRPS|MRPL",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Translation / Ribosome",

      grepl(
        "methyltransferase|histone|deacetylase|HDAC|PRMT|RBBP",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Epigenetic regulation",

      grepl(
        "HSP|heat shock|DNAJ|HIF|AMPK|FoxO|MAPK|JNK|p38|ERK|heat shock factor|HSP27",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Stress response",

      grepl(
        "caspase|apoptosis|p53|BAX|BCL|p53|death receptor|BAX|BCL",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Cell death / Apoptosis",
      
      grepl(
        "metallothionein|ABC transporter|cytochrome P450|CYP",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Metal / Contaminant response",
      
      grepl(
        "NADH dehydrogenase|cytochrome c oxidase|ATPase|electron transport|mitochondrial",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Energy metabolism",
      
      grepl(
        "Actin beta|Actin gamma|Actin binding proteins",
        matched_term,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Cytoskeleton",


      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )


# Create a summary table
candidates_res_interaction <- candidate_hits_res_interaction %>%
  select(
    geneid,
    Category,
    full_name,
    matched_term,
    log2FoldChange,
    stat,
    pvalue,
    padj
  ) %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Reduce table to unique genes
candidates_res_interaction <- candidates_res_interaction %>%
  distinct(geneid, .keep_all = TRUE)

write.csv(candidates_res_interaction, "Unique_candidate_hits_interaction.csv")

# Significant candiate hits
candidates_res_interaction_sig <- candidates_res_interaction %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05)

# Sort by padj
candidates_res_interaction_sig %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  select(
    full_name,
    log2FoldChange,
    padj
  )

write.csv(candidates_res_interaction_sig, "Candidate_genes_res_interaction_sig.csv")
```

### Compare expression between all above comparisons BASED ON THE COMBINED TREATMENT GENE LIST
```{r Comparisons}

# ============================================================
# EXTRACT RESULTS FOR CANDIDATE GENES
# ============================================================

candidate_ids <- unique(candidate_hits$geneid)

get_candidate_results <- function(res, suffix){

  as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("geneid") %>%
    filter(geneid %in% candidate_ids) %>%
    select(
      geneid,
      !!paste0("log2FC_", suffix) := log2FoldChange,
      !!paste0("padj_", suffix) := padj
    )

}

cand_combined <- get_candidate_results(res_21_50, "combined")
cand_temp50   <- get_candidate_results(res_temp_50, "temp50")
cand_sed17    <- get_candidate_results(res_sediment_17, "sed17")
cand_temp0    <- get_candidate_results(res_temp_0, "temp0")
cand_inter    <- get_candidate_results(res_interaction, "interaction")

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# ============================================================
# SETTINGS
# ============================================================

GENES_PER_CATEGORY <- 10
PADJ_CUTOFF <- 0.05

candidate_hits %>%
  group_by(Category, matched_term) %>%
  summarise() %>%
  count(Category)
# ============================================================
# MERGE CONTRASTS
# ============================================================

heatmap_df <-
  cand_combined %>%
  full_join(cand_temp50, by = "geneid") %>%
  full_join(cand_sed17, by = "geneid") %>%
  full_join(cand_temp0, by = "geneid") %>%
  full_join(cand_inter, by = "geneid")

# ============================================================
# SELECT TOP GENES
# ============================================================

top_genes <- candidate_hits %>%
  group_by(Category, matched_term) %>%
  slice_max(
    abs(log2FoldChange),
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  slice_max(
    abs(log2FoldChange),
    n = GENES_PER_CATEGORY,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# KEEP ONLY TOP GENES
# ============================================================

heatmap_top <- heatmap_df %>%
  filter(geneid %in% top_genes$geneid)

# ============================================================
# APPLY SIGNIFICANCE FILTER
# ============================================================

contrasts <- c(
  "combined",
  "temp50",
  "sed17",
  "temp0",
  "interaction"
)

for(i in contrasts){

  fc_col <- paste0("log2FC_", i)
  padj_col <- paste0("padj_", i)

  heatmap_top[[fc_col]][
    is.na(heatmap_top[[padj_col]]) |
      heatmap_top[[padj_col]] > PADJ_CUTOFF
  ] <- NA

}

# ============================================================
# BUILD MATRIX
# ============================================================

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_top %>%
  select(
    geneid,
    log2FC_combined,
    log2FC_temp0,
    log2FC_sed17,
    log2FC_temp50,
    log2FC_interaction
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("geneid") %>%
  as.matrix()

# ============================================================
# REMOVE PROBLEMATIC ROWS
# ============================================================

# Must be significant in at least 2 contrasts

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  rowSums(!is.na(heatmap_mat)) >= 2,
]

# Must have some variation

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  apply(
    heatmap_mat,
    1,
    function(x){

      x <- na.omit(x)

      if(length(x) < 2){
        return(FALSE)
      }

      length(unique(x)) > 1

    }
  ),
]

# Order first while rownames are still geneids
top_genes$Category <- factor(
  top_genes$Category,
  levels = c(
    "Immune signalling",
    "DNA repair",
    "Oxidative stress / Detoxification",
    "Metal / Contaminant response",
    "Cell death / Apoptosis",
    "Energy metabolism",
    "Ciliary function",
    "Cytoskeleton",
    "Epigenetic regulation",
    "Translation / Ribosome",
    "Stress response",
    "Other"
  )
)

gene_order <- top_genes %>%
  filter(geneid %in% rownames(heatmap_mat)) %>%
  arrange(Category)

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  gene_order$geneid,
]

# THEN add readable names
gene_labels <- candidate_hits %>%
  distinct(geneid, matched_term)

new_names <- gene_labels$matched_term[
  match(
    rownames(heatmap_mat),
    gene_labels$geneid
  )
]

new_names[is.na(new_names)] <-
  rownames(heatmap_mat)[is.na(new_names)]

rownames(heatmap_mat) <- make.unique(new_names)


# ============================================================
# COLUMN LABELS
# ============================================================

colnames(heatmap_mat) <- c(
  "Combined",
  "Temperature only",
  "Sediment only",
  "Temperature in sediment",
  "Interaction"
)

# ============================================================
# CHECK MATRIX
# ============================================================

print(dim(heatmap_mat))
print(table(rowSums(!is.na(heatmap_mat))))

# ============================================================
# PLOT
# ============================================================
# Create lookup table
annotation_lookup <- top_genes %>%
  select(geneid, matched_term, Category) %>%
  distinct()

# Match categories to current heatmap rows
row_annotation <- data.frame(
  Category = annotation_lookup$Category[
    match(
      gsub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", rownames(heatmap_mat)),
      annotation_lookup$matched_term
    )
  ]
)

ann_colors <- list(
  Category = c(
    "Immune signalling" = "#E41A1C",          # red
    "DNA repair" = "#377EB8",                 # blue
    "Oxidative stress / Detoxification" = "#4DAF4A", # green
    "Ciliary function" = "#984EA3",           # purple
    "Energy metabolism" = "#FF7F00",          # orange
    "Epigenetic regulation" = "#A65628",      # brown
    "Cell death / Apoptosis" = "#F781BF",     # pink
    "Metal / Contaminant response" = "#257460", # dark green
    "Translation / Ribosome" = "#FFD92F",     # yellow
    "Cytoskeleton" = "#66C2A5",               # teal
    "Stress response" = "#8DA0CB",            # lavender
    "Other" = "#B3B3B3"                       # light grey
  )
)

rownames(row_annotation) <- rownames(heatmap_mat)


#"Among genes that respond most strongly to the combined stressor, what drives that response?"
pheatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  na_col = "#D4D4D4",
  color = colorRampPalette(
    c("#41B3A3", "white", "#E27D60")
  )(100),
  fontsize_row = 8,
  cellheight = 12,
  main = "Candidate gene responses across contrasts"
)

#     c("blue", "white", "red")
#   )(100),
#   fontsize_row = 8,
#   cellheight = 12,
#   main = "Candidate gene responses across contrasts"
# )
# 


sum(res_temp_0$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

sum(res_sediment_17$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

sum(res_temp_50$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

sum(res_interaction$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
```
